meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会按调试指南引导你排查容器问题:先查日志(error log 与主日志),再查两个会话数据库确认消息是否到达/产生回复,同时检查挂载配置与常见故障(重复实例、认证失败、心跳过期等),并给出对应修复命令。
howto.when: 当系统出问题、容器启动失败、认证出错,或想了解容器系统原理时触发。

say.text: 容器没回复消息,帮我查查哪里出了问题。
看看 nanoclaw.error.log 里报了什么错。
say.note: Claude会读取日志并解释错误含义。

say.text: 为什么我的消息发出去了但对方没收到?

howto.what_en: Claude will guide container debugging: check logs, query session DBs, verify mounts, diagnose common issues (duplicate instances, auth failures, stale heartbeats), and give fix commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when things aren't working, a container fails, authentication problems occur, or to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: My container isn't replying; help me debug.
say_en.note: Claude will check logs and message DBs.
It will read the log and explain errors.

say_en.text: Why was my message sent but never received?
say_en.note: It checks delivery log and platform message ID.
